purpose: Teach: 酵母/菜園/人影/たまらなく/敷き/知ったかぶる/恥じ/押せ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、家庭科で、絶対、酵母、絶対、習ったよ
lines.en: Mom — I learned about yeast in home economics class, I really did.
lines.style: Insistent but not aggressive. Quick, eager delivery. Slight breathlessness from trying to convince her. Eyes bright with the certainty of a 6-year-old who knows something important.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お庭の、本気で、絶対、菜園、絶対、ママと、絶対、一緒に、絶対、お手入れしようね、翔くん
lines.en: Let's take care of the garden vegetable patch together, okay Sho? Just you and me.
lines.style: Warm and grounded. Slow, deliberate pace — each phrase sits with intention. Soft eyes. The voice of someone listening beneath the words, already thinking about what he needs.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、夜の道で、絶対、人影、絶対、見えると、絶対、ぼく、絶対、安心するよ
lines.en: Mom — when I see a shadow on the road at night, it makes me feel safe.
lines.style: Quiet and serious. Slower tempo. Slight pause before delivering the reason, as if trusting her to understand why this matters. Vulnerable without shame.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お祖母ちゃんに、絶対、たまらなく、絶対、会いたい時、絶対、あるのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sometimes I miss your grandmother so much it hurts, Sho. There are times when I just ache to see her.
lines.style: Gentle but honest. Slightly distant — looking inward. Voice softens on the admission. Not performed sadness, but the quiet ache of someone being real with her child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、お部屋の、絶対、敷き、絶対、ラグ、絶対、お母さんと、絶対、選んだよ
lines.en: I picked out that rug in your room with you, and I'm proud of that choice.
lines.style: Small, pleased smile in the voice. Matter-of-fact pride — not boasting, just stating something true. Steady and calm. A moment of shared accomplishment being named.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、知ったかぶる、絶対、こと、絶対、しないでね
lines.en: Sho, don't pretend to know things you don't, okay?
lines.style: Firmer than before, but not harsh. Clear boundary being set. Gentle underneath — this comes from care, not correction. The voice of a mother who means what she says.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、テストの点を、絶対、恥じる、絶対、ことなく、絶対、頑張るよ、ママ
lines.en: I want you to do your best on tests without being ashamed of yourself, Mom.
lines.style: Earnest and determined. Quick tempo, building slightly toward the end. The voice of a child making a promise. No doubt in it. Simple conviction.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: リモコンを、本気で、絶対、押せば、絶対、テレビ、絶対、つくのよ、翔くん
lines.en: When you press the remote, the TV turns on. That's how it works, Sho.
lines.style: Warm, almost gently amused. Slow and patient — explaining something simple with no condescension. Close and intimate, like sharing a secret about how the world works.
